visual_review: Native inspected: same D-shaped bow, original nock caps/bindings, grip spiral, straight taut string and open interior retained. Warm deep oiled wood/leather patina, both inlay routes now old gold. Exactly one small flush gilt ferrule on the existing grip and one short old sinew repair binding on lower limb, neither a floating object. Prior caps and inlay remain; no arrow/quiver/extra hardware. Binding produces a small local contour interpretation; measured outline drift requires review, not asserted exact. Review-candidate only.
